title: Signals
description: ~/.local/state/andon/dispatcher/<slug>.signals.json (under XDG_STATE_HOME when set): the record of outside signals of one project, one entry per signal. Written only by the dispatcher (andon signal collect); read by triage, measure and the board. No body or stack trace is kept (a worker reads it from the source). Only these keys.

signals.description: One entry per signal (per fingerprint). Empty when nothing has been seen. fingerprints are unique.

time.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, a real calendar date and time.

source.description: Where it came from (as in project.json signals[].source).

key.description: Id inside the source: <repo>/<workflow>@main for CI, <repo>#<n> for an issue, the issue id for Sentry, Cloudflare and Linear.

url.description: Where a person or a worker reads it.

title.description: The source's title as it is, one line. Untrusted: shown only inside the untrusted fence.

weight.description: now: delivered at once as a notification. later: recorded only, picked up by triage.

fingerprint.description: SHA-1 of source, a newline and key: 40 lowercase hex digits.

count.description: How many collects have seen it.

active.description: Seen by the last collect (false: the CI passed, the issue was closed or resolved).

episodes.description: How many times it appeared: 1 at first, one more each time it disappeared and appeared again.

delivered_episode.description: The episode last delivered as a notification; 0 when none (always 0 for later).

release.description: The release it was seen in: the merge commit's SHA, when the source has one.
